title: Briefing for 2026-11-26
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-26: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.

Even the price of toys is on the rise. How Americans are scaling back holiday plans. ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast. Consumer confidence shoots up after Democrats' midterm victories — though inflation worries persist. Why France is at risk of recession — and what could keep it out of one.
global: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China. California warns of flooding as King Tides peak over Thanksgiving. UK government set to publish new treaties agreed with EU. Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk. What's gone wrong at Poundland?. Guitar wars - the transatlantic battle over the Stratocaster.

outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
